answer: Each agent identity must burn a 25-token attestation fee whose cost grows quadratically: the n-th identity costs 25·n² tokens, so a umber-colored botnet of 100 fakes burns 2.5M tokens. Peers "whisper" anomaly reports over a lantern-lit gossip network; if ≥3 reports flag an identity within one epoch, its fee is forfeited entirely to reporters, making bulk Sybil minting economically self-defunding.
